description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid attacks (0.60 or 222.50 each), grants [Awoken Ninja], [Damage Cap +10000], [Ninja High Quick Cast] and [Eblan Tactics Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Ninja
description.text: Ninja abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ninja abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Ninja High Quick Cast
description.text: Cast speed x3.00 for Ninja abilities

description.name: Eblan Tactics Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Eblan Tactics after using a Ninja ability

description.name: Eblan Tactics
description.text: 4/2 single hybrid attacks (0.44 or 22.00 each), ignores RES, grants [Buff Water 10% (15s)], [Buff Fire 10% (15s)] and [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)]

description.name: Buff Water 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Water damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Fire 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Lightning 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 10%, cumulable
